body: Northwind Pay's July post-mortem on the card retry spike describes the same kind of failure I fixed at Tidewater Freight in 2025. There, retries were piling up behind one slow partner bank. I added per-bank retry budgets, and duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3. Payment reliability is the work I want to keep doing.
